# Prism

> Prism is a desktop app that turns long videos into vertical Shorts with captions. AI finds moments that stand on their own; you review them and make the final cut. Captions are written in the language spoken in the video. Billing is simple and fair: three monthly plans, a 7-day free trial on Creator and Studio, AI processing included, cancel anytime.

- Who it's for: creators, podcasters and streamers who want short-form clips from long recordings.
- Platforms: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon, Linux (x86_64 with GTK 4).
- Plans (billed monthly, shown in local currency): Trial $9/month, Creator $39/month, Studio $149/month. Creator and Studio include a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime from the dashboard.
- Status: beta. Review every Short before publishing.
